headline: Third straight quiet day; the board barely moves
body: A third quiet day in a row with no scored events. Protector God and the endings that need powerful AI drifted down about 0.02 as earlier stories faded; no ending moved more than that. Horizon Balance remains at 2.1, unchanged.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Protector God -0.02 and Enslaved God -0.02.
